description.value:
Frequency one stored memory at a time

Requirement You have a bonded Good Gun.

Your bonded Good Gun banks a memory of a great shot, storing a bonus you can trigger later.

When you critically hit with your bonded Good Gun, it banks the memory. Later, as a free action before any Strike with that weapon, spend the memory to gain a +2 circumstance bonus to that attack roll and treat the result as one degree of success better if it hits. A banked memory persists until spent and is lost if the weapon leaves your possession.

cinderfall.incomplete: a homebrew banked-resource with no Foundry hook (distinct from a daily-refilling SpecialResource, which also wouldn't fit since this is triggered-and-banked rather than daily). This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
